---
title: "Cleaning: Brent and exchange rate"
author: "Marwa Fani and Salma Sbihi"
format: html
---

```{r}
here::i_am("Charm-Prices.Rproj")
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

brent <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "DCOILBRENTEU.csv"), na = c("", "."))
fx    <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "DEXUSEU.csv"),       na = c("", "."))

glimpse(brent)
glimpse(fx)
```
```{r}
oil <- oil |>
  fill(DCOILBRENTEU, DEXUSEU, .direction = "down")

summary(oil)
```

```{r}
oil <- oil |>
  mutate(brent_eur_l = DCOILBRENTEU / DEXUSEU / 158.987)

summary(oil$brent_eur_l)
```
```{r}
dir.create(here("data", "clean"), showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(oil, here("data", "clean", "oil.csv"))
```
